# Required security tests (QH-2a.1, S-12): the `test-security` CI job fails
# unless every entry below was collected AND passed. One entry = one node-id
# prefix (file / class / test); a renamed or deleted entry fails the gate
# instead of silently vanishing, and skip/xfail never count as PASS.
# Allowed skips (none today) go to security-allowed-skips.txt with a reason.
# Checked by .github/scripts/check_required_tests.py.

# S-09 / A-12 — PHI never leaks: anonymisation covers every PHI tag group,
# study-description cleaning, tag-row filtering.
tests/security/test_anonymization.py

# S-08 / A-09 — transport: TLS verification defaults, verify= propagation
# into every httpx client, DIMSE TLS context, URL splitting.
# TestDefaultUrlScheme / TestHttpUrlWarning stay out until the transport-policy
# evaluator (QH-2b) replaces their self-asserting bodies.
tests/security/test_https_enforcement.py::TestTlsSettingsDefaults
tests/security/test_https_enforcement.py::TestOrthancClientTlsPropagation
tests/security/test_https_enforcement.py::TestDimseTlsContext
tests/security/test_https_enforcement.py::TestSplitOrthancUrls

# Credentials never persist in QSettings; log sanitiser strips secrets.
tests/security/test_no_credentials_in_settings.py

# S-11 — bounded network operations: timeouts configured and propagated,
# connections cannot hang, 5xx retried a bounded number of times.
tests/security/test_network_timeouts.py

# Robustness of untrusted input: DICOM UID / path-component validation,
# truncated and nested-sequence DICOM files, QIDO/STOW JSON fuzzing,
# SQL-injection / XSS payloads passed through verbatim as data.
tests/security/test_dicom_fuzzing.py
tests/security/test_api_fuzzing.py

# ONNX model integrity (manifest hash verification before load).
tests/security/test_model_integrity.py
